scope: Detailed Tiangong 1, Tiangong 2 and CSS solar tracking; white outlines remain unanimated.

sources.finding: CMSA reports stable Tiangong-1 attitude and normal Sun-pointing solar arrays.
Wentian solar drive provides two degrees of freedom and continuous tracking.
Wentian and Mengtian turn solar arrays around both the lab axis and wing axis.
CAST describes the T configuration, dual-axis lab arrays and preceding single-degree alternatives.
TG-2 navigation study discusses three-axis Earth-pointing and yaw attitude modes.

implementation: Existing 2 single-axis wing drives each for TG-1/2 retained. Exact historic motor limits and commands are unavailable.
CSS: 2 Tianhe single-axis wings; 4 Wentian/Mengtian wings with two-axis tracking retained.
Nominal +Z nadir / +X orbital-heading body reference is continuous over the orbit. Missing or degenerate velocity cannot flip +Z to zenith.
No arbitrary whole-body Sun spin, yaw schedule or station-control jitter added without dated attitude records.
surface_fix: Opposing identical internal triangle pairs removed at module joins. Exterior surfaces, image bytes, vertex buffers and UVs retained. Light metal roughness increased moderately and high-frequency normal-map strength reduced; reflection remains enabled.
